recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The current build already satisfies FHIR-12372 after later approved naming and careTeam refinements, and adding new careTeam links to addItem would not be supported by the original implementation history or current resource shape.
issue_request: FHIR-12372 was Published/Persuasive for FM and requested moving Claim.item.careTeam, and the equivalent ExplanationOfBenefit item careTeam, to root-level careTeam backbones with 1..1 positiveInt sequence and replacing item-level careTeam with 0..* positiveInt links.
initial_application: Git commit d7b9445f7d0910f6dd2552bd623d21f3c365447b applied Tracker #12372 in 2016 by changing the then-authoritative Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheet sources and examples: it added root careTeam/sequence, disabled item-level careTeam, and added item-level careTeamLinkId. It did not change ClaimResponse, and pre-change addItem definitions had no addItem careTeam element to move or replace.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The Jira's careTeamLinkId name is now represented as careTeamSequence because later Published/Persuasive FHIR-14254 renamed sequence-linking elements from legacy LinkId forms to current Sequence names; that issue already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit. Later FHIR-46624 removed careTeam.responsible from Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit, explaining one current difference from the 2016 backbone without changing the FHIR-12372 conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit StructureDefinitions already contain root careTeam, 1..1 positiveInt careTeam.sequence, and 0..* positiveInt item.careTeamSequence. Current ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit addItem structures were checked and contain provider and sequence-link elements but no stale nested careTeam.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive decision renamed legacy *LinkId sequence references, including careTeamLinkId, to the current *Sequence naming pattern. It already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit.

Later decision removed careTeam.responsible from Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit; this explains a current difference from the original 2016 careTeam backbone and is already represented on the combined branch.
